class ConfigEditor
  read_user() -> UserSnapshot
  replace_user(expected_revision: str, values: UserSettings) -> UserReplaceResult
class ConfigEditorClient(ConfigEditor)
  __init__(transport)
  read_user() -> UserSnapshot
  replace_user(expected_revision: str, values: UserSettings) -> UserReplaceResult
dataclass ConfigObservation
  outcome: ConfigObservationOutcome | None
  cursor: str
  snapshot: Snapshot | None
enum ConfigObservationOutcome
  SNAPSHOT = 'snapshot'
  UNCHANGED = 'unchanged'
  GAP = 'gap'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  UNSUPPORTED = 'unsupported'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
class ConfigObserver
  observe(overrides: RunOverrides, cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> ConfigObservation
class ConfigObserverClient(ConfigObserver)
  __init__(transport)
  observe(overrides: RunOverrides, cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> ConfigObservation
class ConfigReader
  read(overrides: RunOverrides) -> Snapshot
class ConfigReaderClient(ConfigReader)
  __init__(transport)
  read(overrides: RunOverrides) -> Snapshot
class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
const EDITOR_ERROR_CODES
dataclass Origin

  path: str

class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)

  nas_store: str
  store: str

  log_service: str
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
enum ServiceErrorCode
  HANDLER_ERROR = 'handler_error'
  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'
  STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE = 'storage_unavailable'
  CALLER_UNAVAILABLE = 'caller_unavailable'
  IDENTITY_REQUIRED = 'identity_required'
  WRONG_USER = 'wrong_user'
  INVALID_REVISION = 'invalid_revision'
dataclass Snapshot
  nas_store: str
  store: str
  log_sink: str
  log_service: str

  origins: Origins
  stamp: str
enum UserReplaceOutcome
  APPLIED = 'applied'
  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass UserReplaceResult
  outcome: UserReplaceOutcome | None
  snapshot: UserSnapshot
dataclass UserSettings
  nas_store: str
  store: str
  log_sink: str
  log_service: str
  off: dict[str, str]
dataclass UserSnapshot
